topic: Counting Shapes at the Magical Tea Party
title_hi: रंगीला राइम्स: जादुई आकृतियों वाली चाय पार्टी
title_en: Rangeela Rhymes: Magical Shapes Tea Party
description: Join Chintu and Mithu for a magical tea party filled with learning shapes. Perfect for toddlers to learn counting and geometry in a fun way! #Shorts #KidsRhymes #Cartoon
learning: Counting and identifying basic shapes (Circle, Square, Triangle)

scenes.text: अरे! Magic box में क्या छिपा है?
scenes.image_prompt: Cute 3D CGI baby elephant Chintu with a blue scarf looking curiously at a sparkling glowing floating magic box, bright vibrant tea party background, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: One, Two, Three! Let’s open it, wow!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu the parrot with a red cap jumping with excitement as the magic box pops open, colorful magical sparkles flying out, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: देखो, ये है एक गोल-गोल Circle!
scenes.image_prompt: A glowing golden circle shape floating in the air, Chintu pointing at it with his trunk, happy tea party table in background, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: Tap tap tap, two Squares are here!
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu the parrot flying around two blue square-shaped cookies dancing on a plate, very cheerful expression, 9:16 vertical.
Three colorful triangle-shaped sandwiches bouncing on a table, Chintu laughing and clapping his hands, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: Shapes are fun! Ab party shuru!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu sitting at a table with shape-themed treats, enjoying the magical tea party, 9:16 vertical.
Chintu and Mithu doing a happy dance, confetti in the air, bright and high-energy atmosphere, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: Ruko! Magic box में फिर से देखो!
scenes.image_prompt: The magic box closing slightly while Chintu and Mithu look back at it with wide curious eyes, seamless loop transition style, 9:16 vertical.
